basic_profile.bio: I'm an Aussie sci-fi enthusiast currently residing in Melbourne. I work as a software developer for a small tech startup, which means I often have irregular hours, but my evenings are usually free. I love spending my downtime catching up on the latest episodes of Star Trek or diving into a good anime series like Yashahime. When I'm not glued to the screen, I'm either experimenting with my saltwater aquarium or reading up on equality issues. I'm single, and I enjoy spending quiet nights with my cat, Luna. My Reddit activity is sporadic but usually peaks on weekends when I have more free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science from the University of Sydney, which has equipped me with a solid grounding in technology and programming. My interest in sci-fi and fantasy genres has led me to a self-taught understanding of narrative structures and character development through extensive reading and online courses.
